description.en: From “A.O.Z RE-BOOT Gundam・Inre-The dream that the black rabbit saw-”

description.ja: 「ギャプランTR-5[フライルー] (ティターンズ仕様)(A.O.Z RE-BOOT版)」をＨＧシリーズで商品化！
description.en: "Gaplan TR-5 [Flyroo] (Titans specification) (A.O.Z RE-BOOT version)" is commercialized in the HG series!

description.ja: ギャプラン本体のアップデートパーツを採用！
description.en: Adopts updated parts for Gaplan main body!

description.ja: ●　頭部を新規造形で再現！
description.en: ● Reproduce the head with new modeling!

description.ja: 最大の特徴であるガンダムタイプの頭部パーツを新規造形で再現。
description.en: The biggest feature is the Gundam type head parts, which are reproduced with new modeling.

description.ja: ●　ギャプランのアップデートパーツが付属！
description.en: ● Gaplan update parts included!

description.ja: 関節パーツの材質を変更
description.en: Change the material of joint parts

description.ja: ABSが使用されていた関節パーツをKPSに変更し、塗装性が向上。
description.en: Joint parts that used to be made of ABS have been changed to KPS, improving paintability.

description.ja: 肩部外装
description.en: shoulder exterior

description.ja: 肩部はパーツ構成を大きく変更。
description.en: The parts composition of the shoulders has been significantly changed.

description.ja: 分割線が目立たなくなり、パーツでの色再現も向上。
description.en: Parting lines become less noticeable, and color reproduction in parts improves.

description.ja: ハンドパーツ
description.en: hand parts

description.ja: 新規造形の握り手パーツが左右付属。
description.en: Newly shaped grip parts are included for both left and right sides.

description.ja: 股関節パーツ
description.en: hip joint parts

description.ja: 3mm穴を設け、別売りのアクションベースなどに対応した股関節パーツを搭載。
description.en: It has a 3mm hole and is equipped with hip joint parts that are compatible with action bases (sold separately).

description.ja: ●　一部差し換えでMA形態に変形可能。
description.en: ● Can be transformed into MA form by partially replacing it.

description.ja: 付属武装 ：　ロング・ブレード・ライフル
description.en: Attached weapon: Long blade rifle

description.ja: 付属物　：　ディスプレイスタンド
